n: Harvard TinyML edX courses (Fundamentals, Applications, Deploying)
t: Three free Harvard courses on edX about machine learning on tiny devices.
steps: Find the Harvard TinyML series on edX.
Read the course pages and decide which students are ready.
Enroll in Foundations of TinyML first.
Check the age rules on edX before you enroll students.
Decide whether to buy the optional hardware kit for the deployment course.
Move on to Applications of TinyML and then Deploying TinyML.
